sets.title: Voice Recognition
sets.description: Identify active, passive, and impersonal constructions and sort them by type
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите тип конструкции и распределите по категориям

items.prompt: Which sentence uses a passive construction?
options: Мост был построен в прошлом году.
items.answer: Мост был построен в прошлом году.
items.hint: Passive uses был + short participle, with the object as subject.
items.explanation: 'Был построен' is a passive construction: the bridge (мост) receives the action. The agent (who built it) is omitted.

items.promptEnglish: Choose the sentence with no named subject.
options: В больнице принимают с восьми утра.
items.answer: В больнице принимают с восьми утра.
items.hint: Impersonal uses 3rd person plural with no explicit subject.
items.explanation: 'Принимают' without a subject is impersonal: 'they see patients from 8 AM' expresses a general rule without naming who does it.

items.prompt: Which sounds most natural in casual conversation?
items.hint: Colloquial Russian prefers active voice with a clear subject.
items.explanation: Active voice with a named subject (директор подписал) sounds direct and personal, typical of everyday speech.

items.prompt: A scientific report would most likely say:
options: Эксперимент был проведён в лабораторных условиях.
items.answer: Эксперимент был проведён в лабораторных условиях.
items.hint: Scientific writing uses passive to focus on the experiment, not the experimenter.
items.explanation: Scientific register uses passive (был проведён) to sound objective. Active 'мы провели' is too personal for academic papers.

items.prompt: "Здесь не курят" is an example of:
items.hint: No named subject, 3rd person plural verb expressing a general rule.
items.explanation: 'Здесь не курят' uses 3rd person plural without a subject. This impersonal construction expresses a general prohibition.

items.prompt: "Статья публикуется в журнале" uses which passive type?
items.hint: The -ся suffix on the verb creates a reflexive passive.
items.explanation: 'Публикуется' (is being published) is a reflexive passive formed with -ся. It emphasizes the ongoing process.

items.prompt: When is passive voice preferred in Russian?
items.promptEnglish: Choose the best context for passive.
options: Telling a friend about your weekend
items.hint: Passive is the default register for formal/official texts.
items.explanation: Official reports, scientific papers, and legal documents prefer passive because it sounds objective and impersonal.

items.promptEnglish: A new record has been set. (headline style)
items.hint: Headlines use short passive participles without auxiliary verbs.
items.explanation: 'Установлен новый рекорд' is a typical headline: short passive participle, no agent, concise and factual.

items.prompt: Which construction expresses 'People say that...' impersonally?
items.promptEnglish: How do you say 'they say' without naming who?
items.hint: 3rd person plural without subject = impersonal 'they say'.
items.explanation: 'Говорят, что...' (they say that...) is a classic impersonal construction. No subject is named because the source is general/unknown.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort each sentence by its construction type.

items.word: В этом районе строят новые дома.

sets.title: Active or Passive?
sets.description: Choose between active and passive forms in context, then fill in the blanks
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите правильную форму залога и заполните пропуски

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: My friend wrote this book. (personal, informal)
minimalPairs.explanation: Active voice (написал) is natural in casual speech when the agent is known and important.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The book was written in 2023. (formal, agent unimportant)
minimalPairs.explanation: Passive (была написана) is formal. The focus is on the book, not the author.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The building has been under construction for three years. (ongoing)
minimalPairs.explanation: Reflexive passive 'строится' emphasizes an ongoing process. 'Построено' would mean it is already completed.
Short participle 'построено' signals a completed result. 'Строится' would mean it is still being built.

minimalPairs.context: General truth: В Японии много _____ рис.
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: In Japan, people eat a lot of rice. (general habit)
minimalPairs.explanation: Impersonal 'едят' (3rd person plural, no subject) expresses a general cultural habit.

minimalPairs.context: Official notice: Вход в здание _____ после 22:00.
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Entry to the building is prohibited after 10 PM.
minimalPairs.explanation: Short passive participle 'запрещён' is the standard form for official notices and signs.

blanks: Formal: Письмо _____ вчера вечером. (The letter was sent yesterday evening.)
Casual: Сергей _____ этот торт сам. (Sergei baked this cake himself.)
Scientific: Результаты _____ в таблице 3. (The results are presented in Table 3.)
Impersonal: В России много _____ чаю. (In Russia, people drink a lot of tea.)
Headline: _____ новый закон о налогах. (A new tax law has been adopted.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Choosing the correct voice form by register
hints: Formal past passive: было + short participle (neuter to match письмо).
Casual active: subject + past tense verb.
Scientific writing uses short passive participles for data presentation.
Headlines use short passive participles without auxiliary verbs.
explanations: 'Было отправлено' (was sent) is formal passive. The neuter form matches 'письмо'.
Active voice 'испёк' names the doer (Сергей) directly, natural in casual speech.
'Представлены' (are presented) is a short passive participle. Scientific texts focus on data, not the researcher.
'Пьют' without a subject is impersonal: a general statement about Russian culture.
'Принят' is a headline-style short participle: concise, no auxiliary verb, agent omitted.

sets.title: Build and Translate
sets.description: Build passive and impersonal sentences from words, then translate English into the correct Russian voice
sets.descriptionRussian: Составьте предложения из слов и переведите на русский с правильным залогом

translation.hint: Formal passive: subject + был + short participle + time.

translation.english: People don't do that here. (general rule)
translation.hint: Impersonal: 3rd person plural, no subject, expresses a general rule.

translation.english: The article was published in a scientific journal.
translation.answer: Статья была опубликована в научном журнале.
translation.hint: Passive: subject + была + short participle. Agent omitted.

translation.english: They say this restaurant is very good.
translation.answer: Говорят, что этот ресторан очень хороший.

items.prompt: Translate using passive: 'The letter was received this morning.'
items.explanation: Passive: 'Письмо было получено сегодня утром.' The letter is the grammatical subject receiving the action.

items.prompt: Which sentence correctly uses instrumental for the agent?
items.hint: The agent (doer) in passive voice takes the instrumental case.
items.explanation: 'Художником' (by the artist) is instrumental case. This is the standard way to express the agent in Russian passive constructions.

items.prompt: How would a formal notice say 'Parking is prohibited'?
items.hint: Official signs use verbal noun + short passive participle.
items.explanation: 'Парковка запрещена' uses a verbal noun (парковка) + passive participle (запрещена), the standard form for official prohibitions.

errorCorrection.sentence: Дом строили рабочими. (intended: The house was built by workers.)
errorCorrection.hint: Active verb + instrumental agent is wrong. Use short passive participle + instrumental.
errorCorrection.explanation: Active 'строили' cannot take an instrumental agent. Passive 'построен рабочими' is correct.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: A comprehensive review combining all voice types and exercise formats
sets.descriptionRussian: Комплексное повторение всех типов залога и конструкций

items.prompt: Official report: Нарушения _____ в ходе проверки.
items.promptEnglish: Violations were identified during the inspection.
items.hint: Official reports use passive: были + short participle.
items.explanation: 'Были выявлены' is formal passive, standard for inspection reports. Active 'выявили' would be too colloquial.

items.prompt: Casual story: Мой брат _____ всю мебель в квартире.
items.promptEnglish: My brother assembled all the furniture. (casual narrative)
items.hint: Casual narrative uses active voice with a named subject.
items.explanation: In casual storytelling, active 'собрал' with a named subject (мой брат) is natural and direct.

items.prompt: General observation: В Москве _____ очень быстро.
items.promptEnglish: In Moscow, people drive very fast. (general truth)
items.hint: Impersonal: 3rd person plural, no subject, general observation.
items.explanation: 'Ездят' without a subject is impersonal, expressing a general observation about Moscow traffic.

items.prompt: Which pair correctly shows active to passive transformation?
options: Студент сдал экзамен. / Экзамен сдан студенту.
Студент сдал экзамен. / Экзамен сдан студентом.
Студент сдал экзамен. / Экзамен сдали студента.
Студент сдал экзамен. / Экзамен сдаётся студенту.
items.answer: Студент сдал экзамен. / Экзамен сдан студентом.
items.hint: In passive, the agent goes to instrumental case (студентом).
items.explanation: Active subject (студент) becomes instrumental agent (студентом) in passive. The object (экзамен) becomes the subject.

items.prompt: Why does Russian prefer passive in legal texts?
items.promptEnglish: What is the functional purpose of passive in law?
options: It emphasizes the action and result over the doer
It is shorter than active voice
items.answer: It emphasizes the action and result over the doer
items.hint: Legal texts focus on what happened and its consequences, not on individuals.
items.explanation: Passive voice in legal/official texts foregrounds the action ('Закон принят' - the law was adopted) over who specifically acted.

items.prompt: Choose the reflexive passive: Этот вопрос _____ на заседании.
items.promptEnglish: This issue is being discussed at the meeting. (ongoing process)
items.hint: Reflexive passive (-ся) emphasizes an ongoing process.
items.explanation: 'Обсуждается' (is being discussed) is reflexive passive, showing the process is in progress right now.

errorCorrection.sentence: Задача решена студент. (The task was solved by the student.)
errorCorrection.hint: The agent in passive voice must be in the instrumental case.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Студентом' (instrumental) is required after a passive participle. Nominative 'студент' is only for active voice subjects.

errorCorrection.sentence: Работа выполняет каждый день. (The work is done every day.)
errorCorrection.hint: Without a named subject, you need reflexive passive -ся.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Выполняется' (is being done) is reflexive passive. Active 'выполняет' requires a subject: someone performs the work.

errorCorrection.sentence: Экзамены были сданы студентов. (The exams were passed by the students.)
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Студентами' (instrumental plural) is correct. Genitive 'студентов' is wrong here because the agent in passive uses instrumental.

errorCorrection.sentence: Письмо отправлена утром. (The letter was sent in the morning.)
errorCorrection.hint: Short participle must agree in gender with the subject. Письмо is neuter.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Письмо' is neuter, so the participle must be neuter too: 'отправлено', not feminine 'отправлена'.

minimalPairs.explanation: Personal narrative uses active voice. 'Бабушка связала' is warm and direct, emphasizing who made the sweater.

minimalPairs.context: Product label: Свитер _____ из натуральной шерсти.
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The sweater is made of natural wool. (product description)
minimalPairs.explanation: Product descriptions use passive: 'связан из шерсти' focuses on the product, not the maker.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: In the countryside, people get up early. (general truth)
minimalPairs.explanation: Impersonal 'встают' (3rd person plural, no subject) expresses a general truth about village life.
